ai_innovation_index.definition: Composite future index covering verified research-to-prototype, startup/service, testing, adoption, talent, compute, data, and international-network indicators. Weighting and normalization are not defined in Gate A.
ai_innovation_index.measurement_method: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.
ai_innovation_index.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
ai_innovation_index.reason: Future monitoring KPI; baseline not established.
ai_innovation_index.monitoring_definition: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.

appeal_response_target_hours.definition: Proposed target for first human response to a documented appeal, pending service-hours and staffing design.
appeal_response_target_hours.measurement_method: Future appeal ledger after service protocol is approved; no current SLA is confirmed.
appeal_response_target_hours.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
appeal_response_target_hours.target_definition: Proposed target for first human response to a documented appeal, pending service-hours and staffing design.

capital_ip_service_case_count.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
capital_ip_service_case_count.reason: Future monitoring KPI; baseline not established.
capital_ip_service_case_count.monitoring_definition: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.

compute_service_capacity_gpu_hours_month.definition: Auditable GPU-equivalent service hours made available through JZOI-linked lawful compute services per month.
compute_service_capacity_gpu_hours_month.measurement_method: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.
compute_service_capacity_gpu_hours_month.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
compute_service_capacity_gpu_hours_month.reason: Future monitoring KPI; baseline not established.
compute_service_capacity_gpu_hours_month.monitoring_definition: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.

lawful_dataset_access_count.definition: Count of datasets made available to a JZOI project with source, license/legal basis, purpose, retention, and access controls documented.
lawful_dataset_access_count.measurement_method: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.
lawful_dataset_access_count.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
lawful_dataset_access_count.reason: Future monitoring KPI; baseline not established.
lawful_dataset_access_count.monitoring_definition: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.

operational_service_coverage.formula: covered required service periods / required service periods
operational_service_coverage.definition: Share of required scenario service periods covered by staffed capacity and published service hours.
operational_service_coverage.measurement_method: Requires service-hours, roster, capacity, and incident records.
operational_service_coverage.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
operational_service_coverage.reason: Current value is unknown; required evidence or baseline is not available.

physical_human_review_feature_count.definition: Count of distinct accepted Gate B physical staffed review or human-desk feature IDs used by scenarios.
physical_human_review_feature_count.measurement_method: Distinct serialized Gate B feature IDs; not a policy boolean.
physical_human_review_feature_count.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
physical_human_review_feature_count.target_definition: Count of distinct accepted Gate B physical staffed review or human-desk feature IDs used by scenarios.

policy_fallback_coverage.formula: scenarios with structured fallback requirement / all scenarios
policy_fallback_coverage.definition: Share of scenarios with a policy-level non-digital fallback requirement and named fallback feature relation.
policy_fallback_coverage.measurement_method: Registry policy check only; not a distance or capacity claim.
policy_fallback_coverage.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
policy_fallback_coverage.target_definition: Share of scenarios with a policy-level non-digital fallback requirement and named fallback feature relation.

prototype_to_adoption_conversion.formula: prototypes with documented adoption decision / prototypes entering controlled testing in the same cohort
prototype_to_adoption_conversion.definition: Share of prototypes entering controlled testing that later pass human/professional review and receive a documented time-bounded adoption decision.
prototype_to_adoption_conversion.denominator: prototypes entering controlled testing in the same cohort
prototype_to_adoption_conversion.measurement_method: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.
prototype_to_adoption_conversion.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
prototype_to_adoption_conversion.reason: Future monitoring KPI; baseline not established.
prototype_to_adoption_conversion.monitoring_definition: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.

public_interface_space_capacity_sqm.definition: Measured usable indoor and sheltered public-interface space that meets access, fire, and operating-hour criteria.
public_interface_space_capacity_sqm.measurement_method: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.
public_interface_space_capacity_sqm.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
public_interface_space_capacity_sqm.reason: Current value is unknown; required evidence or baseline is not available.

public_interface_uptime_target.formula: available public-interface hours / planned public-interface hours
public_interface_uptime_target.definition: Proposed share of planned public-interface hours with a published staffed or fallback service state.
public_interface_uptime_target.measurement_method: Future service-hours log after staffing and operating agreement; no current value is asserted.
public_interface_uptime_target.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
public_interface_uptime_target.target_definition: Proposed share of planned public-interface hours with a published staffed or fallback service state.

scenario_human_review_required_count.definition: Count of scenarios whose structured human_review.required is true.
scenario_human_review_required_count.measurement_method: Registry count; not a physical-feature count.
scenario_human_review_required_count.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
scenario_human_review_required_count.target_definition: Count of scenarios whose structured human_review.required is true.

spatial_service_coverage.formula: verified served demand points / measured demand points
spatial_service_coverage.definition: Measured share of scenario demand points within an accepted staffed-service approach relation after accessibility survey.
spatial_service_coverage.measurement_method: Requires accessibility survey, service-distance method, and capacity data.
spatial_service_coverage.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
spatial_service_coverage.reason: Accessibility survey and service-distance evidence are not yet available.

talent_density.formula: verified eligible persons / verified occupied AI ecosystem space in hectares
talent_density.definition: Verified eligible AI research, startup, professional-service, and operations personnel divided by verified occupied AI ecosystem space.
talent_density.denominator: verified occupied AI ecosystem space in hectares
talent_density.measurement_method: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.
talent_density.limitation: Gate C design/provisional registry value; not a statutory or surveyed existing-condition fact.
talent_density.reason: Future monitoring KPI; baseline not established.
talent_density.monitoring_definition: Define and validate a privacy-safe measurement protocol before reporting a value.

site_area_sqm.formula: Area of the provisional SITE_BOUNDARY compatibility frame.
site_area_sqm.reason: Legacy visual/spatial contract metric derived only within provisional projected geometry; not an observed site fact or statutory control.

green_ratio.formula: Projected GREEN_SPACE union divided by provisional SITE_BOUNDARY area.

public_space_ratio.formula: Projected polygonal PUBLIC_SPACE/AI service union divided by provisional SITE_BOUNDARY area.
